issues.issue: Mixed line: General Fund part is Rentals and fees 17,315 + Licenses and permits 2,002 (p13 Total column), Street Fund part 14,790 is not broken down (p11). Rentals is only about 51% of it. Also the same printed label in the Street Fund schedule (detail[91]) is categorised licenses and permits, so one label has two categories in this report.
The same label on the statement (receipts[5]) is categorised Rentals. The rules call for one category per label within a report. Neither is clearly wrong because the line is a mix.

The Statement of Activities (p2) reports this as Operating Grants and Contributions and does not say who gave it. Some of it may be government grants (intergovernmental/state aid or federal grants) rather than private donations.
